title: Right Token, Right Time: From Per-Token Gating to Trajectory-Aware Activation Steering
abstract: arXiv:2611.18274v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Activation steering via sparse autoencoders (SAEs) enables behavioral control of large language models without task-specific fine-tuning. Yet, standard methods apply the steering signal at every generated token, displacing representations from the distribution the model was trained on and eroding generation quality. We show that \emph{when} along a generation the intervention is applied is a decisive axis of control. We cast steering as a per-token allocation problem under a fixed budget of steerable tokens, so that methods differ only in which tokens they select, making allocation the sole variable. Within this framework we introduce two gates. The first, Contrastive Feature Projection (CFP), is memoryless and selects the tokens least aligned with the target behavior through a sparse, interpretable feature projection. The second, Closed-Loop Adaptive Bernoulli Steering (CLABS), is trajectory aware. It treats allocation as closed-loop

translated_title: 正确的词元，正确的时机：从逐词元门控到轨迹感知的激活引导
translated_abstract: 通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）进行的激活引导能够在无需任务特定微调的情况下对大型语言模型实现行为控制。然而，标准方法会在生成的每一个词元上都施加引导信号，这会使模型表示偏离其训练时所处的分布，从而损害生成质量。我们证明了在生成过程中“何时”施加干预是决定控制效果的一个关键维度。我们将引导问题形式化为在固定可引导词元预算下的逐词元分配问题，使不同方法之间的差异仅体现在其选择的词元上，从而让分配方式成为唯一变量。在该框架下，我们引入了两种门控机制：第一种是对比特征投影（Contrastive Feature Projection, CFP），它是无记忆的，通过稀疏且可解释的特征投影来选择与目标行为最不对齐的词元；第二种是闭环自适应伯努利引导，它是轨迹感知的，将分配视为一个闭环过程。
tldr: 该论文将基于稀疏自编码器的激活引导重构为固定预算下的逐词元分配问题，并提出无记忆的对比特征投影（CFP）与轨迹感知的闭环自适应伯努利引导（CLABS）两种门控机制，通过只在恰当的词元和时机施加干预来避免分布偏移、保持生成质量。
en_tdlr: This paper reframes SAE-based activation steering as a per-token allocation problem under a fixed budget, proposing two gates—memoryless Contrastive Feature Projection (CFP) and trajectory-aware Closed-Loop Adaptive Bernoulli Steering (CLABS)—that intervene only at the right tokens and moments to prevent distribution shift and preserve generation quality.
